instruction: In scenes/Player.tscn finish the Player CharacterBody2D by switching motion_mode to Floating, adding an AnimatedSprite2D that uses the Isometric Mini-Crusader sprite set with animations idle0 through idle7 and run0 through run7 (default to idle0, with animation speed scale 2.0), and add a CollisionShape2D rectangle positioned at (7, 44) with a 66x24 size so the collider hugs the feet. Note that animations are ordered in clockwise order starting from right, so idle0 should face right, idle1 faces bottom-right, idle2 faces bottom, etc.; the same applies to run0 through run7. For Each spritesheet can be sliced into 8*N regions (do not set margins, trim empty space, or do anything like that). Use the crusader_idle spritesheet for the idle animation, but crusader_walk for the run animations. Name the nodes the same as each node's class names (AnimatedSprite2D and CollisionShape2D, case sensitive).
